statutory_dues.text:
The Company is regular in depositing with appropriate authorities undisputed statutory dues including goods and services tax, provident fund, employees’ state insurance, income-tax, duty of customs and other statutory dues applicable to it. The provisions for sales-tax, service tax, duty of excise, value added tax and cess are not applicable to the Company. According to the information and explanations given to us and based on audit procedures performed by us, no undisputed amounts payable in respect of these statutory dues were outstanding, at the year end, for a period of more than six months from the date they became payable.

timeline.summary: N. Akhila Reddy declared no encumbrance on Rain Industries shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,520.73 Cr (+20.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹121.44 Cr (against a loss of ₹137.69 Cr a year earlier).
In Q1 CY26, Rain Industries reported consolidated revenue of ₹4,520.7 Cr and adjusted EBITDA of ₹714.9 Cr.
Rain Industries Limited’s 51st AGM held on May 12, 2026, electronically, with 112 members present via VC; Chairman Brian Jude McNamara presided.
In May 2026, Rain Industries held its Q1 CY26 earnings Q&A session discussing carbon segment demand and debt reduction.
N. Sujith Kumar Reddy declared no encumbrance on Rain Industries shares as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
